# P35.12 — Release identity v2 + clock guards

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/294_P35.12__release-identity-v2-and-clock-guards.md` (manifest row **294**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11C; deps P35.4 + P35.6, gate `none`). **Requirement ids stamped:** **SIG-REL-001** (release identity: label, export id, descriptor schema), **SIG-REL-002** (promotion refusals), **SIG-REL-003** (clock guards / date-truth), plus SIG-EXPORT-003 (BuildSpec reproducibility) and SIG-REL-014 (resolver code identity carried forward). **Base:** `r11/P35.4-ops-runbook-v2` · **Live leg:** none — every surface here is local/registry-scoped; no hosted mutation runs under this row.

## What ships

- **`exports/src/exports/release_identity.py`** (new) — the identity half of the G3 model:
  - `sig.publication-descriptor/2` writer (`descriptor_v2_document`) + fail-closed validator (`validate_descriptor`) carrying every §3.2 field: `label`, `environment`, `snapshot` (`as_of_world`, `as_of_belief`, `belief_pinned`, `spine_watermark`, `materialize_run`, `sqitch_head`, `restore_point`), `export` (`id`, `input_manifest_sha256`, `content_key`), `code` (`commit`, `repository`, `tree`, `images.export`), `renderer` + J3 TX-13b `site_renderer`, `versions` (ruleset/resolver/policy/projection/search-index/ontology + generated sha), `gates`, `evaluation`, `disclosures`, `compartment_projections`, `evidence_root`, `dossier_root`, `transparency_root`, `boundaries_root` (declared as the K4/JUR-01 input row 297 fills), `build` (`built_at`, `publish_class`, `replay_reason`).
  - **`sig-YYYY-MM-DD.N` labels** — the date derives from `snapshot.as_of_world`, never typed; `allocate_label` holds `labels.lock` (flock) and appends to `registry/labels.json` (`sig.release-labels/1`) atomically — two same-day exports can never mint the same label, and catalog publications of the date keep their ordinals occupied.
  - **`sig-export-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>-<key8>`** — `key8` is the leading sha256 of the export-id inputs: the §38.1 reproducibility tuple *plus* the full instants, spine watermark, code commit, environment and replay — the NEW-1 collision is structurally impossible.
  - **§3.3 clock guards** — `assert_not_frozen` (AR-3 monthly day6 00:00Z→day13 12:00Z + daily 03:00–06:30Z, lifted only by a recorded `--emergency`); `host_clock_report` (remote HTTP `Date`, |skew| ≤ 120 s, refusal on fetch failure; `--skip-host-clock-check` records a declared skip); `check_as_of_clock` (unparseable/future as-of refused; earlier-day requires `--replay` → Class S); `descriptor_clock_failures` (`as_of_world ≤ as_of_belief ≤ built_at ≤ now+5m`); `emitted_date_failures`/`emitted_file_date_failures` (no emitted stamp later than `built_at`, allow-listed real-world fields exempt).
  - **SIG-REL-002 `promotion_refusals`** — v1/foreign schema, non-40-hex `code.commit`, dirty tree (recorded or live-probed), unpushed/unverifiable commit, `0.0.0`/missing version fields, malformed label, `as_of_world` earlier than the latest release — every reason named.
- **`exports/src/exports/manifest.py`** — `BuildSpec` gains `as_of_snapshot_instant`, `as_of_belief_instant`, `belief_pinned`, `spine_watermark`, `code_commit`, `environment`, `replay`, `materialize_run`, `sqitch_head`, `restore_point`; `release_id()` mints the keyed `sig-export-…` id; `snapshot_block()` feeds the descriptor. `bundle_io.py` parses v1 and v2 descriptors.
- **`exports/src/exports/spine_export.py`** — T0 read **exactly once** (`generated_at`, injectable for tests/replay); a typed `--as-of` later than T0 refuses **before any DB read**; the sqitch head is read inside the same `REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY` snapshot as every other spine read.
- **`exports/src/exports/release.py`** — `build_release` defaults to v2 (`--schema-version 1` retained for legacy parity); `renderer_revision` is required for v1 and refused for v2 (one code identity, NEW-3); the emitted-date scan runs fail-closed over descriptor/catalog/report/landings after emit; `activate()` enforces `activated_at ≥ built_at` on v2; **`promote()`** = the SIG-REL-002 gate, refusing every named reason and otherwise running the identical `activate()` path — the registry is the caller's local directory, nothing hosted is touched.
- **`exports/src/exports/cli.py`** — `build --from-spine` gains `--belief`, `--environment`, `--replay`, `--emergency`, `--skip-host-clock-check`, `--host-clock-url`; `release` gains `promote` and `label-allocate`; `release build` defaults `--schema-version 2`.
- **`ops/gcp/export.sh`** — `SIG_EXPORT_BELIEF`/`SIG_EXPORT_ENVIRONMENT`/`SIG_EXPORT_REPLAY`/`SIG_EXPORT_EMERGENCY` propagate into the in-container command; `SIG_EXPORT_AS_OF` rides `--as-of` as before; append-only prefixes unchanged.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_candidate.py`** — threads `generated_at` so synthetic-clock candidate runs stay legal under the future-as-of guard (the T0 injection seam).
- **`ops/disclosures.toml`** — the `sig.disclosures/1` registry the v2 descriptor digests.
- **`api/src/api/release_serving.py`** — v1/v2 compat: reads `snapshot.as_of_world` with the flat v1 field as fallback.
- **`versioning.py`** — `code_commit`/`code_tree` probes (commit read from the tree, never typed — GT-7); resolver identity `<resolution version>+g<commit8>`.
